title.zh: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】
title.en: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】

current_state.zh: Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay now lets users send USDC directly into their existing OnePay checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, bypassing exchange conversion.
current_state.en: Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay now lets users send USDC directly into their existing OnePay checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, bypassing exchange conversion.

updates.title_zh: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】
updates.title_en: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】
updates.what_changed_zh:
沃尔玛旗下金融科技应用 OnePay 宣布，用户现在可以将 USDC 稳定币直接发送至 OnePay 账户，资金会自动进入其现有的支票账户余额，用于支付账单和转账，无需再经过交易所转换。

该功能省去了交易所兑换环节，使这一锚定美元的稳定币持有者可以直接在沃尔玛支持的消费级应用内将资金用于账单支付和转账。

OnePay 表示，相关银行服务由 Coastal Community Bank 或 Lead Bank 提供。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay now lets users send USDC directly into their existing OnePay checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, bypassing exchange conversion.
updates.background_zh: USDC 是一种设计为锚定美元、可按 1:1 兑换美元的稳定币，其储备为存放于美国受监管金融机构隔离账户中的美元计价资产。OnePay 是一家由沃尔玛多数持股的金融科技公司，正从支付向更多业务扩展，包括于 2025 年 9 月推出自有品牌 OnePay Wireless 手机套餐。Coastal Community Bank 是位于美国华盛顿州西北部的一家社区银行，通过其 CCBX 部门提供银行即服务（BaaS）。
updates.background_en: USDC is a stablecoin designed to be pegged to the US dollar and redeemable 1:1 for dollars, backed by dollar-denominated assets held in segregated accounts with US regulated financial institutions. OnePay is a fintech firm majority owned by Walmart that has been expanding beyond payments, including the launch of its own OnePay Wireless phone plans in September 2025. Coastal Community Bank is a community bank in Northwest Washington that provides banking-as-a-service through its CCBX division.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于稳定币的分发而非交易：一家面向大众零售用户的金融科技应用将 USDC 直接计入支票账户余额，为这一稳定币提供了绕开交易所兑换的消费支付出口，可能对 USDC 作为支付通道的需求形成支撑。目前其影响范围仅限于单一应用的功能及其合作银行，而非整个稳定币市场。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is stablecoin distribution rather than trading: a mass-retail fintech app crediting USDC directly into a checking balance gives the stablecoin a consumer payment outlet that bypasses exchange conversion, potentially supporting demand for USDC as a payment rail. Exposure is currently confined to a single app's feature set and its bank partners, not the wider stablecoin market.
